intro: Dallas keeps its lights on late, a downtown of glass towers and parking garages that outlast the people who work inside them. This page is for that drive home, and for cases that only pretend to be finished. A guest book line nobody can explain. A confession that closed a death without settling it. Notes someone refused to file away. I assembled this lineup for the Case Files letter, then set the door in Dallas, Texas, so readers here have a page of their own. The Ryan Kane Series is not set in Texas, and these picks are not a report from a local precinct. Cara Toner's The Ones Worth Keeping and Jemma Stark's Cold Hard Murder are linked once each below. After them, The Log runs on this page for about three minutes: seven days of notes kept by someone watching a man who lives in his car. That story is original companion fiction, not a chapter of HUNTED. Ryan has been sleeping in his car in Phoenix, and somebody is keeping a log on him. If you want the longer file, the prequel waits as a BookFunnel download. Fractured Ground is the Kindle novel after that prequel. Digital Ascent, book three, is a free advance copy. Dallas is the doorway. The open file is what you take with you.
